<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)>That’s what we’re about to find out! I gotta go scope out

<$cdef(27)>
to
go

Follow me!

<$cdef(27)>?

<$voicel(2,3)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Well, since you asked, I guess I’m feelin’ a bit hungry...

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,20)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)>Hold on, I’ve got an idea! I think I know what we should

Anyway, last but not least—let’s scope out the <$cdef(27)>fourth floor!
<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,664)><$facial(2,4)>Come on, the <$cdef(27)>fourth floor</color> is the last one! Follow me!

<$voicel(2,7)>The <$cdef(27)>fourth floor has a kinda luxurious vibe, don’t ya think?
<$voicel(2,3)>How do ya think we should fix this floor up,
<$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Oooh, I get what you’re saying. I like it!
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>Oooh, I get what you’re saying. I like it!

<$voicel(2,7)><$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,1)>I think we’ve seen everything we need to, so let’s head

<$voicel(2,9)><$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,664)><$facial(2,4)>I’d say we’re done pokin’ around. Let’s head back down!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)>All right! Scope-out complete!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Oho! So, what’s your conclusion? Do you think we can

<$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,8)>You bet! I’ve got a good idea for how we can pull it off.
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,824)>Gonna need a lot of materials, though, and <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,5)>help from all

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Understood! How can I start helping?
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)>Gimme just one sec... Hup... OOF!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>Just take a look at this <$cdef(27)>building kit. It’ll show you
everything we need!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,49)>To start with, we’re gonna need all these materials! Think
